svg.title: Threat-model your merge conflict: the resolution that quietly deletes a coworker's commit
svg.desc: Two git branches converging on a merge node beside a conflict-marker block; the incoming branch's commit is struck through with an X, showing a coworker's change deleted at resolution. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Threat-model your merge conflict: the resolution that quietly deletes a coworker's commit”. A manhattan lattice probed by 2 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 685493.
